scope: Strict private success-response contract for the location-scoped strategy plan listing.

constraints.extra_fields: forbidden at all response object levels
constraints.plan_fields: exact safe 22-column projection returned by the bounded SQL function
constraints.enums: strategy status, visibility, cascade, and structural gate constraints align with schema/function checks
constraints.counts: strict nonnegative integers; version is a strict positive integer
constraints.timestamps: updated_at must be timezone-aware; planning horizon end cannot precede start
constraints.pagination: maximum 50 plans aligns with route/service page size and SQL function limit 51 including the lookahead row; accepted offset and next_offset are capped at 10,000; has_more is true only when a continuation offset remains within that cap
constraints.privacy: free-text rationale, party identities, private amounts, and execution authority are excluded

error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

checks.command: python3 -m ruff check services/gateway/strategy_reads.py services/gateway/strategy_routes.py tests/test_gateway_strategy_response.py tests/test_gateway_strategy_reads.py
python3 -m py_compile services/gateway/strategy_reads.py services/gateway/strategy_routes.py tests/test_gateway_strategy_response.py tests/test_gateway_strategy_reads.py

limitations: The route accepts starting offsets through 10,000. If a page reaches the cap and more source rows remain, the response terminates pagination without advertising an unsupported next offset.
This closes the route response-contract slice; live OIDC, populated-data parity, and broader tenant-isolation acceptance remain separate.
